# Sample style guide

A short guide written for plumbcheck's tests.

<a id="s1-naming"></a>
## 1 Naming and structure

<a id="s1.1-names"></a>
### 1.1 Names

Name functions and variables in snake_case and classes in CapWords.

#### 1.1.1 Why

Readers tell kinds apart at a glance.

<a id="s1.2-functions"></a>
### 1.2 Functions

Keep functions small enough to read in one sitting.

<a id="s2-documentation"></a>
## 2 Documentation

<a id="s2.1-docstrings"></a>
### 2.1 Docstrings

Give every public function a docstring.
